_comment_display: 3x QVue projection display behind a DS90UH983/DS90UH988 link (hh983-serializer config_mode=2). Its RH850 F1KM 'Qvue_IOC' at 0x32 dims each of the three displays; the daemon drives all three with one level. The output is write-only: any read from 0x32, or an i2cdetect probe, hangs the MCU and the 988 until a power cycle.
_comment_sensor: The QVue has no ambient light sensor, so sensor.type=null: the daemon boots straight into MANUAL mode and is driven over its socket (Stream Deck brightness keys, disp-settings). AUTO mode is refused with SENSOR_UNAVAILABLE. The zones below are required by the config schema but unused.
_comment_output: value_range is the MCU's 12-bit dimming value: 0 is backlight off, 40 (0x028) is the lowest value measured to light it, so 0 % stays just visible. The response is linear in the raw value (about 1.6 nits per count on full white), so response_exponent 2.2 bends the percent scale to step evenly to the eye: 0 % = raw 40 (~40 nits), 10 % = raw 66 (~90 nits), 50 % = raw 923 (~1,440 nits), 100 % = raw 4095. The MCU firmware sometimes overrides the requested level on its own (seen hot: display 1 jumped to ~4,800 nits, its 77 % thermal-derating level, even with single frames and no daemon running); the write-only daemon cannot see or correct that.
_comment_calibration: calibrations/qvue_3x.csv is a REFERENCE table for display 1, interpolated from i1 Display Pro HL full-white spot readings on 2026-10-30, not a per-step sweep; values above 3,000 nits exceed the meter's rated range and 100 % is extrapolated.
